title: aquilegia vulgaris subsp. jucunda
intro: Aquilegia vulgaris subsp. jucunda, commonly known as the common columbine or granny's flower, is a species of flowering plant in the buttercup family Ranunculaceae. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Aquilegia vulgaris subsp. jucunda include sedative and anti-anxiety effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and glycosides, that have been shown to have a calming effect on the nervous system.
